title: WATCH OUT FOR THIS BEFORE YOU SAY STOCK MARKET CRASH!
speaker: Money Making Market host

macro_themes.view: Bears technically control the tape, but one confirmation of 2-hour bullish divergences on SPY/QQQ and a VIX lower high would flip it.

calls.condition: If the 2-hour SPY divergence confirms up (and VIX makes a lower high), daily turns positive and points to the 796.10 annual expected move / 800; if divergences fail, bear continuation.
calls.reason: Daily MACD still in positive territory near center line; 2-hour MACD and RSI divergences formed but not confirmed.
calls.quote: By the end of 2026 I do see this market going to 800 until the market shows me something that proves that completely wrong

calls.condition: If the QQQ 2-hour divergence/double bottom confirms up, test the high and make a new one; otherwise could flush to weekly expected move.
calls.reason: Significant 2-hour RSI and MACD divergence while price makes new lows; daily near center line with no reversal signal.
calls.quote: If the daily is able to curl up here, it's going positive, which means test the high, go make a new one

calls.condition: If 30-minute confirms up, test the high; retaking 296.32 with a daily higher low is bullish, a roll from ~285 would be bearish.
calls.reason: 30-minute positive trend with no reversal signal after small MACD/RSI divergence; no daily divergence.
calls.quote: as of right now, the 30-minute is in a positive trend with no reversal signal

calls.condition: If 2-hour VIX crosses down forming a lower high, a squeeze higher in stocks is likely.
calls.reason: VIX up 14.1% in a day implies ~85% odds of a reversal update within two sessions; still pointed up with no downside confirmation.
calls.quote: As of right now, volatility is heading to the upside and you have no confirmation that any downside is coming

notes: Host not named. No date said; 'into Friday'/'tomorrow' suggests recorded Thursday evening (likely 2026-10-22); listing date used. Short-term biases are conditional on divergence confirmations, hence 'mixed'.
